Title: Verify text fields accept valid Name, Email, Phone and Address
Preconditions: Browser is launched; practice site home page (https://testautomationpractice.blogspot.com/) is open
Test Data: Name: Allah Ditta; Email: allah.ditta@example.com; Phone: 3001234567; Address: House 10, Street 5, Islamabad, Pakistan
Steps: 1. Enter a valid name in the Name field 2. Enter a valid email in the Email field 3. Enter a phone number in the Phone field 4. Enter an address in the Address field 5. Read back the value of every field
Expected Result: Every field shows exactly the value that was entered

Title: Verify Gender radio buttons are mutually exclusive
Preconditions: Browser is launched; practice site home page (https://testautomationpractice.blogspot.com/) is open
Steps: 1. Select the 'Male' radio button 2. Verify Male is selected and Female is not 3. Select the 'Female' radio button 4. Verify Female is selected and Male is not
Expected Result: Only one radio button is selected at any time; selecting Female deselects Male

Title: Verify all Days checkboxes can be selected and unselected
Preconditions: Browser is launched; practice site home page (https://testautomationpractice.blogspot.com/) is open
Test Data: Days: Sunday, Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday
Steps: 1. Tick all 7 day checkboxes (Sunday to Saturday) 2. Verify all 7 are selected 3. Untick all 7 checkboxes 4. Verify none is selected
Expected Result: All checkboxes toggle independently; after unticking, no day remains selected

Title: Verify only the selected Days checkboxes are checked
Preconditions: Browser is launched; practice site home page (https://testautomationpractice.blogspot.com/) is open
Steps: 1. Tick 'Monday' 2. Tick 'Friday' 3. Read the state of all 7 day checkboxes
Expected Result: Only Monday and Friday are selected; the other 5 days stay unselected

Title: Verify the complete Data Entry Form can be filled end to end
Preconditions: Browser is launched; practice site home page (https://testautomationpractice.blogspot.com/) is open
Test Data: Name: Allah Ditta; Gender: Male; Day: Saturday; Country: Japan; Color: Blue; Animal: Zebra
Steps: 1. Fill Name, Email, Phone and Address 2. Select gender Male 3. Tick Saturday 4. Select country Japan 5. Select color Blue 6. Select animal Zebra 7. Verify every control holds the chosen value
